answer: Every claim climbs the bridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
